purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Penang Seberang Perai Tengah District and Land Office says its district includes Bukit Mertajam and gives its Bukit Mertajam office address. A JUPEM-credited Penang cadastral lot layer returned one complete polygon intersecting the exact WUP point with only UPI and FID requested. This verifies a local land office and a point-matched parcel reference, without asserting full municipal coverage or legal boundary accuracy.
